summary: A DocsSearch dialog opened from an Open search button over a two-entry index, showing the selected href afterwards.
use: Docs site search opened by a button or shortcut that jumps to a page or heading.
spec: `<Button variant="outlined" onclick={() => (open = true)}>` labelled Open search
`index` typed `DocsSearchEntry[]` has 2 entries (Send text, Webhooks) with `href`, `title`, `section`, `description`, `headings` and `text`
`<span class="picked" aria-live="polite">` shows Selected plus the chosen href
